evals.name: forecast-review-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Commit deals are Alder Freight, Birch Analytics, Dunmore Retail and Elm Logistics (total 250000). Birch fails on a past close date, probability under 50 and a vague next step. Dunmore fails on an early stage, probability 30, no next step and one contact. Alder and Elm hold. Value at risk is 108000 of 250000.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
Birch Analytics and Dunmore Retail are listed as failing with cited cells
Alder Freight and Elm Logistics are counted as holding and not listed

evals.name: forecast-review-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run forecast-review on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
